set.body: Every item is a live contradiction of a stated guarantee; do first. (1) Fix learned-metric admission: derive metric_status from metric estimation/capabilities instead of hard-coded 'fixed' (evidence-sampling.R:113); replace inherits(effect_crossnobis_plan) type test with a capability check (evidence-sampling-product.R:371); preserve frozen/training_signature through support restriction (evidence-sampling-product.R:86-96); read or delete calibration_requires_metric_uncertainty; bind learned_frozen provenance to a real training object, not a 64-hex regex (metric.R:155, source.R:3). (2) Typed generalization axis: pairing(generalizes_over=) bound into task+metric identity so cross-run vs cross-session differ under generic labels; revisit independence='independent' default (pairing.R:17). (3) Route-stable scientific_plan_id: rdm(plan) vs rdm(geometry(plan)) must hash identically; add id-equality assertions (test-geometry-plan.R:150). (4) Classed effect_capability_refusal condition (pattern at tomography.R:236) carrying capability/all-reasons/remedies; real sentences+tests for the 8 cryptic sampling reasons. (5) Gallery cases 1+3 as named refusals: rdm(normalize=), contrast(remove_univariate=), gated on guaranteed_psd (currently computed, gates nothing). (6) Honest tests: floating-point tiling-invariance fixture w/ declared tolerance incl. query-fused path (test-effect-form-certification.R:109; drift ~5e-15 measured); bind q=120 sampling-cov artifact to a q=120 plan (contrast-width check in evidence-sampling-kernel.R:79-98); public-level rdm/rsa recomposition tests (only contrast is guarded; relates bd-01KZZZK8KSM6V41ZAJP24S9ST9). (7) Conservation honesty: searchlights() default vs 'conservative'; document+test total-only conservation (coherent residual 2.49 measured); export frame_conservation(); geometry_spectrum(component=) non-additivity warning (relates bd-01KZYN6JGQA67G78Q4BJC6RHZW). (8) Kill silent fallbacks: pmin/pmax clip + silent pseudo-inverse in measurement-decomposition.R:263-308; allow_projection default; plan_crossnobis check order misdiagnosis (crossnobis.R:227-253); legible unequal-run-length error. Acceptance: tests for every refusal and identity; R CMD check clean.
set.title: Phase 1: Integrity — nothing may contradict the contract
